title: Find Numbers with Even Number of Digits
goal: Count positive integers with an even number of decimal digits.
strategy: Count decimal digits rather than testing the parity of the number itself.

phasePurposes.inspect: Count decimal digits rather than testing the parity of the number itself.
phasePurposes.update: Only numbers whose decimal digit count is even contribute to the count.
phasePurposes.done: Only numbers whose decimal digit count is even contribute to the count.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
